title: BEC departments content
description: Per-department content keyed by the URL slug used in /departments/<type>/<slug>. Only `name` is required; fill the rest as content arrives.

assetSlug.description: R2 folder slug under departments/ for photos (not an asset key).

hero.description: Full-bleed hero at the top of the department page. One image renders it still; two or more render a rolling carousel with arrows and autoplay.

chronicleImage.description: Asset key for a "Department Chronicle" timeline graphic shown as a full-width banner at the top of the Home tab, before the overview.

degree.description: The degree this department admits to. Labels the Intake quick-stat ("B.E. Intake"); the Science & Humanities departments award none and leave it unset.

quickFacts.description: Department-specific "Quick Facts" panel shown on the Home tab. Only rendered when set.

nbaAccredited.description: When true, surfaces an "NBA Accredited" card in the Home quick-stats row.

caption.description: Shown beneath the photo, e.g. "Teaching Faculty".

alt.description: What the photo shows, for a screen reader. Only needed where the surrounding page's own wording would describe it wrongly.

width.description: Overrides the layout's default width for this photo.

overviewPhoto.description: Lead image shown above the Home overview (e.g. the department group photo).

hodMessage.description: Message from the Head of Department, shown on the Home tab.

caption.description: Shown beneath the photo, e.g. "Teaching Faculty".

alt.description: What the photo shows, for a screen reader. Only needed where the surrounding page's own wording would describe it wrongly.

width.description: Overrides the layout's default width for this photo.

aboutPhoto.description: Lead image shown above the "About Department" body (e.g. the teaching-faculty group photo).

programsOfferedCount.description: Overrides the "Programs Offered" stat count when the listed bullets expand a single programme into multiple recognition tracks (e.g. one Ph.D. shown as its VTU and AICTE-QIP variants). Defaults to programsOffered.length when unset.

coursesOffered.description: Courses taught by the department (distinct from degree programmes), shown as a separate "Courses Offered" list under Academics.

programStructure.description: Programme structure facts (duration, semesters, total credits) shown under Academics.

pos.description: Programme Outcomes — rendered alongside PEOs/PSOs in the Academics section.

wk.description: Knowledge and Attitude Profile (WK) — rendered alongside PEOs/PSOs/POs.

values.description: Core values shown as a bullet list under the Home overview (e.g. IPE).

newsletters.description: Monthly department newsletters, rendered as a documents section.

milestones.description: Department milestones, shown under Vision & Mission on the About tab.

researchAchievements.description: Achievements that do not fit a table — patents granted, best-paper awards. Rendered as bullets under "Research Achievements".

publications.description: Year-wise research output grouped by category (journals, books, chapters, conferences).

achievementTables.description: Free-form awards/achievements tables (faculty awards, student projects, participations, chapter awards).

collapsed.description: Render behind a collapsed disclosure (long rosters that would otherwise bury the section).

studentAchievements.description: Student achievements — month-wise narrative highlights, plus optional Best Outgoing Students and alumni-entrepreneur tables.

startups.description: Incubated startups — companies registered and grants received.

distinguishedAlumni.description: Distinguished alumni — gallery of name + designation + organization, with an optional portrait (initials shown when absent).

testimonials.description: Alumni testimonials — rendered as quote cards under an "Alumni" section.

alumniRecords.description: Alumni record PDFs — rendered as a downloadable "Alumni Records" section.

patents.description: Patents filed/published/granted — rendered as a table on the Research page.

collapsed.description: Render behind a collapsed disclosure (long rosters that would otherwise bury the section).

infrastructureLabs.description: Labs shown under the Infrastructure tab (title + caption + images), separate from `labs` which render under Research.

placementsPhoto.description: Group photo of placed students, shown as a captioned banner at the end of the Placements section.

placementImages.description: Placement infographics (e.g. year-wise placement data, training structure) shown above the Placements tables.

caption.description: Shown beneath the photo, e.g. "Teaching Faculty".

alt.description: What the photo shows, for a screen reader. Only needed where the surrounding page's own wording would describe it wrongly.

width.description: Overrides the layout's default width for this photo.

homeGroupPhoto.description: Group photo shown as a captioned banner at the very end of the department Home tab (e.g. the graduating batch).

facilitiesGallery.description: Categorised facility photos (classrooms, labs, library, campus), shown as captioned galleries on the Facilities tab.

role.description: Which table this person appears in when `groupSupportingStaff` splits the roster. Ignored otherwise.

affiliation.description: Designation and institution, shown as a third column. A group where nobody has one renders two columns.

facilitiesTables.description: Free-form tables shown under the Facilities tab (Infrastructure Details).

researchLaboratories.description: Plain list of research-laboratory names shown as a leading table in the Facilities section.

details.description: Labelled facts (resource person, participants, budget, outcomes…) shown as bullets.

images.description: Captioned event photos rendered as a gallery under the activity.

activityTables.description: Department activity programmes (SDPs, FDPs, workshops) rendered as titled tables under an "Activities" section.

width.description: Overrides the layout's default width for this photo.

photo.description: Group photo of the association's office bearers, shown as a captioned banner at the end of the section.

exicom.description: Student executive committee (exicom) — office bearers and the positions they hold.

exicomGroups.description: Coordinator teams listed by category (e.g. Technical, Program, Sports, Cultural, Media).

collapsed.description: Render behind a collapsed disclosure (long rosters that would otherwise bury the section).

gallery.description: Asset keys for an activity-highlights photo gallery shown at the end of the section.

events.description: Events organised by the association (name + date + coordinators), shown as a list.

mouImages.description: Asset keys for MoU signing photos, shown as a gallery under the MoUs section.

researchGallery.description: Research-laboratory photo galleries shown under the Research section (title + asset keys).

curriculumGroups.description: Curriculum shown as labelled sub-tabs (e.g. Scheme of Teaching & Examinations / Syllabus). A tab holds either a flat `documents` grid, or `sections` — labelled blocks each with their own grid.

sectionDocuments.description: Extra PDFs attached to a specific section, keyed by section id (research, mou, facilities, faculty…).

sectionNavDocuments.description: PDFs linked straight from a section's sidebar entry (sub-links that open the file), keyed by section id — e.g. a faculty-on-roll sheet under Teaching Faculty.

sectionEmbeds.description: PDFs embedded inline (rendered in a viewer) under a specific section, keyed by section id.

customSections.description: Free-form extra sections (own sidebar tab) with intro copy, inline-embedded PDFs and/or download links.

bestPractices.description: Best-practices PDFs surfaced on the department Home tab.

bestPracticesList.description: Best practices shown as text (practice + year) on the Home tab, instead of a PDF link.

alumniMentorship.description: Render the Alumni Mentorship Program block under Alumni. Its copy still lives in components/academics/departments/eee-mentorship.tsx — only the department that runs the programme is content-controlled.

layout.description: Where this department's blocks appear. Nothing here changes what the department says — only which tab a block lands on, what a section is called, and which tabs exist at all.

achievementsUnderResearch.description: When true, the Ph.D.s/Scholars/Grants tables render inside the Research tab and no standalone "Research Achievements" tab is emitted.

hideResearchTab.description: When true, removes the Research / Research Achievements tab entirely.

labsUnderFacilities.description: When true, `labs` render on the Facilities tab and the equipment/software tables move into the Research tab instead.

activitiesUnderAssociation.description: When true, `activities` render at the end of the Association section and no standalone "Activities" tab is emitted.

bestPracticesUnderAbout.description: Move the Best Practices block out of the Home tab and under "About Department".

hodMessageUnderAbout.description: Move the HoD message and lead photo out of the Home tab and under "About Department".

groupPhotosUnderAbout.description: Move the teaching-faculty group photo to the About Department tab.

overviewPhotoOnHome.description: When true, keeps the overview photo on the Home tab even if the HOD message is moved to About.

hideAboutTab.description: When true, removes the About Department tab/sidebar link entirely.

sectionOrder.description: Explicit whitelist + ordering of sidebar entries, by section id ("home" and "about" included). Ids absent from the list are dropped entirely; without it the nav falls back to the order sections happen to be built in.

sectionTitles.description: Per-department section heading overrides, keyed by section id.

sectionNavLabels.description: Per-department sidebar label overrides, keyed by section id.

sectionIcons.description: Per-department section icon overrides (sidebar + heading), keyed by section id.

hideInfrastructureQuantity.description: Drop the "Quantity" column from the infrastructure/equipment table for this department.

visionMissionOnHome.description: Show Vision & Mission on the Home tab (after the overview) and move the HoD message, lead photo and Highlights under "About Department".

academicsOnHome.description: Drop the Academics tab and render its groups (programs, PEOs, POs, WK, PSOs) under the Home overview instead.

hideQuickStats.description: Hide the "at a glance" stats row on Home (e.g. when the Quick Facts panel replaces it).

milestonesOnHome.description: Show Milestones on the Home tab, in place of the Highlights block, instead of under "About Department".

groupSupportingStaff.description: Split Supporting Staff into "Technical Staff" and "Supporting Staff", by each person's `role`.

staffCards.description: Render Supporting Staff as photo cards (like teaching faculty) instead of tables.

facultyCompact.description: Render faculty/staff cards in a compact layout with a small portrait instead of the full-width photo.

placementsSummaryOnly.description: Placements: show only summary/recruiter tables, hide per-student name lists.

galleryExclude.description: Asset-key substrings to drop from the infrastructure gallery (e.g. stray portrait shots).

departments.description: Map of content key (URL slug, or type/slug for PG) -> department content.
